claim_ceiling: This record demonstrates one false-negative relative to a known immutable committed occurrence. It does not establish why indexing differed, quantify the false-negative rate, or complete repository-history coverage.
next_action: Use a complete accessible ref inventory and reachable commit/tree traversal as the authoritative repository-history test, retaining code search only as a bounded discovery accelerator.
